_comment: Private economics rate-card template (plan §4, NH-0034/NH-0036). Copy it into an owner-controlled mode-0700 directory as an ignored mode-0600, single-link file and fill every null with ACTUAL provider-account and account/channel rates plus owner-approved projected monthly paid-cohort counts for every profile on both web and Apple. Zero is allowed for an individual profile/channel cell, but a channel with zero projected paid users fails its channel gate. Capture the card only after the completed acceptance evidence and use it within 24 hours. Standard/deep operation p95 plus script p95 and tool/search costs come only from the tenant-scoped read-only production snapshot bound into the ten-script acceptance evidence. The simulator uses the greater of current-rate recomputed model cost and resolved measured model cost, then adds measured provider-tool cost exactly once; ten-credit script profiles use the higher measured Standard or Scheduled total. The complete profile-by-channel matrix weights the blended and per-channel gates and is digest-bound into the private artifact. The web subscription-plus-pack profile incurs two Stripe fixed transaction fees because the subscription and one-time pack use separate Checkout charges. Do not substitute public list prices when the account contract or invoice provides the applicable rate.
